newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AMPLATS SAYS SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE MERGER.
newsitem.headline: AMPLATS SAYS SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE MERGER.

text.p: Anglo American Platinum Corp Ltd (Amplats) said on Tuesday that shareholders had approved the merger of its operating companies into a single listed firm, Rustenburg Platinum Holdings (RPH).
Shareholders had also agreed to Amplats' disposal of its shareholdings in unlisted diamond trading companies, it said.
The announcement follows a statement on July 16, in which the company said its restructuring into a single listed entity using RPH as the vehicle would take effect on September 1.
RPH's name would be changed to Anglo American Platinum Corp Ltd and it would commence its listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange and the London Stock Exchange from September 1.
The listings of Amplats, Potgietersrust Platinums Ltd (PPRust) and Lebowa Platinum Mines would be terminated on the JSE from the start of trading on September 1.
Likewise, PPRust and Leplats' listings on the LSE would be terminated on the the same date.
Following the restructuring, Amplats would become a wholly-owned subsidiary of RPH and PPRust. Leplats would be 100 percent owned by Amplats and RPH.
Amplats said on Tuesday it would apply to South Africa's High Court to sanction the scheme and that a further announcement would be made shortly thereafter.
